headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty remained volatile while Tata Motors and GST collections showed strong growth

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Net GST collections surged 25.6% to ₹2.03 trillion, marking the fastest growth in FY27
Tata Motors reported a boom in October sales with PVs up 23% and CVs up 27%
Crude oil prices remained elevated above $116 per barrel, contributing to market volatility
IT and Pharma sectors provided support to the indices during the final sessions of October
whatHappening: Markets are currently closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, November 2
Global beverage majors are advancing their Indian IPO plans, including DRHP filings and board approvals
Solex Energy is planning an international debut by targeting the US market
IL&FS has approached the NCLT to recover ₹186 crore in excess pay from former directors
summary: The Indian market concluded its last session with volatility as IT and Pharma gains were balanced against sliding midcaps and high crude prices. Strong economic indicators emerged with GST collections hitting a record ₹2.03 trillion and Tata Motors reporting significant October sales growth. Investors are now looking toward the new week, monitoring geopolitical risks and corporate earnings for a potential market rebound.
